source: https://www.fumadocs.dev/ (static HTML + compiled CSS fetched 2026-08-03; browser extension unavailable, so extraction is from markup/tokens plus downloaded hero imagery, not live rendering)

color.palette_type: two-layer system: a strictly neutral gray docs UI (the fd-* token layer every Fumadocs site inherits) topped by a warm citrus 'landing' brand layer (orange/olive light, pale-yellow/tangerine dark) used only on fumadocs.dev's own marketing surfaces

docs_ui_light.note: app-shell gray, not white — content sits on #f5f5f5 with translucent 50%-alpha borders; primary is near-black ink

docs_ui_dark.sidebar_overrides: the sidebar re-scopes tokens (#292929 muted, #2e2e2e secondary, #b8b8b8 muted-foreground) — surfaces brighten one step inside the nav rail
docs_ui_dark.note: material-style #121212 dark, translucent alpha borders and accents throughout

landing_brand.note: landing copy is olive-khaki, not gray — body text itself carries the brand warmth; brand flips hue by theme (burnt orange in light, pale butter yellow in dark) with the other citrus as secondary

color.section_accent_theming: distinctive mechanism: --color-fd-primary is swapped per docs area via CSS vars — UI docs get blue (--ui-color #297bff light / #a9ceff dark), Headless gets violet (--headless-color #4b2ce8 / #a9f), Framework gets amber (--framework-color #cc8b00 / #fff383), and the landing sets it to var(--color-brand); one token swap re-themes sidebar active states, links, and accents per section

semantic.diff: code-diff tokens: add #0eb4641a bg / #0ac864 symbol, remove #c80a641f bg / #e60a64 symbol

color.contrast_strategy: docs: quiet gray-on-gray layering with alpha borders, near-black/near-white primary; landing: olive text on light gray with saturated citrus reserved for headings, badges, and pill CTAs

typography.heading_font: Geist (next/font variable) — same face for everything
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (next/font) — code blocks, terminal demos, and marketing section labels; KaTeX fonts loaded for math

heading_scale.h1_hero: text-4xl → text-5xl (36→48px) / weight 500 / leading-tighter — modest for a landing hero
heading_scale.h2_section: text-3xl–4xl / weight 500 / tracking-tight / text-brand / centered ('Docs for Engineers.', 'Not Just Engineers.', 'Open Source Forever.')
heading_scale.h2_mono_variant: some section h2s go JetBrains Mono UPPERCASE: 'TRY IT OUT' as a bordered rounded-xl badge (font-bold, border-2 border-brand/50), 'BUILD YOUR DOCS' at extrabold — terminal-flavored section markers
heading_scale.docs_h1: 1.75em / weight 600 (docs pages stay small and functional)

typography.body_scale: docs body is dominated by text-sm (14px) — 117 uses on /docs vs 1 text-lg; landing lead paragraphs run text-2xl–4xl font-light for the big claim, then text-sm elsewhere
typography.weights: 400/500 backbone; 300 (font-light) for oversized landing statements; 600–800 only in mono uppercase moments
typography.font_style_notes: single neutral grotesque (Geist) + JetBrains Mono as the personality font; headings differentiate via brand color and mono/uppercase treatment rather than size extremes

spacing.content_density: docs: compact 14px UI with comfortable prose; landing: airy grid gaps (gap-10, mt-12/20)
spacing.section_rhythm: landing sections stack in a 2-col lg grid with generous gaps; docs use standard prose rhythm

layout.grid_system: landing: max-w-[1400px] frame with 1–2 col feature grid; --spacing-page token = 1436px; docs: Fumadocs three-column (sidebar tree / prose / TOC), --fd-layout-width 1400px
layout.hero_pattern: hero is a giant framed panel: min-h-600px, 70vh, rounded-2xl, 1px border, overflow-hidden, containing badge + h1 + pill CTA pair + a faux CLI/terminal sequence ('pnpm create fumadocs-app' → framework picker → localhost:3000 'New App launched!') over a dithered photo background
layout.landing_structure: framed hero → testimonial marquee (shadcn, Anthony Shew, Aiden Bai, David Blass quotes, DOM repeated 4x for seamless loop) → theme previews (Docs/Notebook/OpenAPI tabs) → 'Anybody can write.' MDX feature tour with live code samples (Writer/Developer/Automation tabs) → per-audience sections with brand-colored centered h2s → showcase logos → open-source/sponsors → mono uppercase 'BUILD YOUR DOCS' CTA
layout.docs_layout: the reference Fumadocs UI itself: icon-annotated sidebar groups, breadcrumbless h1 + one-line description, 'Copy Markdown' + 'Open' buttons above content, 2x2 card grid for sub-products, info callout with left accent, right-rail 'On this page' with nested indent lines
layout.alignment: landing alternates centered (hero, section h2s) and left-aligned feature columns; docs strictly left

shape.radius_scale: rounded-full for all landing CTAs and badges (pill-first); rounded-xl/2xl (12/16px) for frames, cards, code panels; docs components on Tailwind defaults (--radius-sm .25rem → --radius-2xl 1rem)
shape.border_usage: 1px translucent borders everywhere (#cccccc80 light / #6663 dark) — the alpha-border approach lets one token work on any surface; border-2 with /50 opacity for the mono badge h2s
shape.rule: marketing is pill+16px, docs UI is 6–12px — softer and rounder than the Langfuse/Vercel school

elevation.shadow_style: shadow-lg is the workhorse on landing cards/frames; docs UI nearly flat, relying on surface steps (#121212 → #191919 → #212121) and alpha borders
elevation.depth_cues: surface tone + translucent borders first; linear-gradient fade masks (white→transparent) blend section edges instead of hard cuts

iconography.style: Lucide stroke icons at size-4 (16px) in nav, sidebar group labels, and feature cards

motion.philosophy: functional transitions plus a few crafted loops; no GSAP/Three.js/Framer on the landing (verified absent)
motion.keyframes_observed: fumari-marquee / fumari-marquee-vertical (40s duration testimonial loop, horizontal + vertical variants), circuit_1 (element sliding translateY -20→100px) + circuit_1_x_energy (a pulse that stays invisible 46% of the loop, flashes visible, then travels 212px and fades — an energy packet running along a circuit trace), fd-sidebar/popover/dialog/fade in-out pairs, enter/exit (tw-animate), accordion equivalents
motion.durations: UI transitions via transition-colors defaults; marquee 40s; docs panels use fd-* enter/exit animations

components.button_primary_landing: pill: px-5 py-3 rounded-full font-medium tracking-tight bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-200 (orange→brighter orange light; butter-yellow→paler dark)
components.button_secondary_landing: same pill geometry, border + bg-fd-secondary, hover:bg-fd-accent
components.hero_badge: text-xs text-brand rounded-full border border-brand/50 p-2 — tagline chip above the h1
components.search: ⌘K search trigger in header; Algolia/Orama-backed dialog in docs
components.terminal_demo: faux CLI walkthrough as hero imagery: JetBrains Mono, clack-style prompts (◇ Project name, ◆ Choose a framework with radio list Next.js/Waku/Tanstack Start/React Router), then a browser chrome frame 'localhost:3000 — New App launched!'
components.code_blocks: Shiki-highlighted, tabbed codeblock groups (tab="Tab 1"), Twoslash type-info popovers, [!code ++] diff decorations with the fd-diff tokens, filename headers, copy buttons
components.testimonial_cards: quote + avatar + name + role rows inside the 40s marquee
components.docs_cards: 2x2 grid of icon + bold title + text-sm description cards on card surface with alpha border
components.callouts: left-accent info/warn/error/success/idea boxes using the oklch semantic set
components.theme_tabs: Docs / Notebook / OpenAPI theme preview switcher — the product demos itself as the component library

design_style.mood: crafted, warm, indie, developer-cozy, quietly playful
design_style.personality: a solo-craftsman open-source project that presents like a boutique product — 'beautifully designed by Fuma Nama' is in the hero copy; personality comes from citrus color, mono uppercase badges, a dithered-photo hero, and celebrity-developer testimonials rather than corporate polish
design_style.genre: open-source dev-tool landing in the shadcn-era style ('The shadcn/ui for docs' is a literal section heading): neutral gray component UI + one strong brand accent + composability as the core pitch
design_style.visual_language: two voices deliberately separated — the docs UI is a disciplined neutral-gray shadcn-style system (alpha borders, #121212 dark, text-sm everywhere) while the landing wraps it in warm olive body text, citrus pills, halftone-print imagery, and JetBrains Mono accents; the product screenshot IS the main imagery
design_style.signature_imagery: duotone halftone-dithered photography — the hero background is a real photo (streetlamp against clouds and trees) reduced to amber-on-navy dot dithering like a risograph/newsprint print; retro print texture against a clean UI
design_style.composition: everything framed: hero in a rounded-2xl border frame, demos in browser/terminal chrome, screenshots in cards; sections join via white→transparent gradient fade masks; testimonial proof runs as an infinite marquee
design_style.copy_voice: personal and direct ('the React.js docs framework you love', 'Build excellent documentation, your style.', 'Anybody can write.'); problem-empathy openers ('You know how you end up rebuilding a full docs site every time…'); proof by named peers (shadcn, Vercel, Million.js, ArkType creators) rather than corporate logos
design_style.interaction_feel: standard fast color transitions; the delight lives in ambient loops (marquee, circuit energy pulses) and the CLI storytelling, not in hover theatrics

overview.performance_tier: lightweight — pure CSS animations and pre-rendered imagery; no canvas, no WebGL, no JS animation libraries (verified: zero <canvas>, no three/gsap/rive/lottie/framer in payload)
overview.composite_notes: Extraction was from static HTML/CSS plus downloaded assets (hero bg viewed as image); runtime pacing of the circuit pulse and marquee inferred from keyframe definitions. The aesthetic trick is cheap-but-distinctive: dithered duotone photos and CSS-only loops instead of runtime rendering.

dithered_imagery.details: signature effect: photographic backgrounds pre-processed into 2-color halftone dot dithering (amber #dd7627-family on navy) — retro print/risograph texture; shipped as static PNG (bg-2.png, 2208x1242) inside the hero frame, likely theme-variant

marquee_loops.details: fumari-marquee component: 40s infinite testimonial scroll with horizontal and vertical variants, content repeated 4x in DOM for seamless wrap

circuit_animation.details: CSS-only 'circuit board' decoration: circuit_1 slides a trace element vertically while circuit_1_x_energy runs a glow pulse along a 212px path with long invisible dwell (0–46% opacity 0) — reads as electricity traveling through PCB traces

gradient_fade_masks.details: sections blend via linear-gradient(to bottom, white 40%, transparent 90%) style overlay fades rather than hard borders

glassmorphism.note: translucency is limited to alpha borders/accents, no frosted blur panels

text_effects.note: headings static; emphasis via text-brand color spans inside sentences

svg_animations.note: SVGs are static logos and Lucide icons; the animated circuit is DOM elements + CSS keyframes
